summary: Container apps (Ghost, Nextcloud, Uptime Kuma, n8n, Gitea, Plausible, Jellyfin), app backup and restore, S3 presets, app health alerts and OS updates. `sudo kaname update` updates from the server, with a database dump and automatic rollback. A new terminal installer. Ubuntu: waits for unattended-upgrades and refuses snap Docker. Kaname by FutureForge Studios. Migrations 0010-0012 are additive.
